findings.explanation: -30d is a time range, not a condition, and the SPL has no alert logic; it is a trend chart (description vs spl).
findings.suggested_fix: Describe it as a 30-day hourly trend of people counts per camera, with no alert threshold, or define one.

findings.explanation: A bare regulatory mention without saying what to review (retention of counts, no biometric data, DPIA).
findings.suggested_fix: State what the review covers or point to the policy document.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `coalesce(people_count, occupancy)` mixes counters/interval counts with occupancy gauges, then `sum(count)` per hour double-counts gauge snapshots.

`match(lower(analytic_type), "(?i)people|occupancy|count")` matches any analytic whose type contains 'count' (for example vehicle count). The default timechart limit of 10 series also folds extra cameras into OTHER.

summary: A trend panel described as alerting; summing occupancy-type readings and a broad regex make the counts unreliable. Privacy note is a single fragment.
